Name: Vanilla Kitchen Furniture
Author: sexynes
Description:
Adds vanilla kitchen as furniture to the furniture catalog, including shelves and cabinets as paintings, and can open the kitchen menu on most kitchen furniture with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] mod.
